raw_response:
This plot is for beans and other legumes, intercropped, so I do not put much chemical fertilizer here — I save any FISP coupons I might get for my maize plots. Beans fix their own nitrogen, and I have watched my crop grow well without urea on them. I will use seed I saved from last year's harvest, as buying improved legume seed is expensive and the local varieties do fine for home eating and selling small amounts at market. I weed by hand with my family and will only hire a little help at planting if the rains come heavy.
